lessons_used: 'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been overestimated compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

candidates.title: new_pet_interaction_overview_screen
candidates.change: Adds a new end-of-onboarding screen explaining desktop pet tray controls, hiding, and interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about users being confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_pet_interaction_overview.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_interaction_overview.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to access commands, hide, or customize settings.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: waiting_progress_tips_carousel
candidates.change: Displays animated status progress and estimated time while pet creation finalizes during waiting.
candidates.why: Home stage has a long median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s) where users might feel stuck or unsure.

waiting.hint: We are bringing your pet to life on your desktop...

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen while retaining its core function and showing a real progress wait.

candidates.score_note: Home step has extreme wait times (201s median / 2336s mean); visual progress feedback reduces anxiety during wait.

candidates.title: choose_path_split_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a split view directly comparing pet companion options.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating hesitation during path selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns the choose path layout while retaining path selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Choose path has high mean duration, but redesigns historically perform poorly across multiple test types.

candidates.title: pick_friend_trait_hint
candidates.change: Adds an reassuring hint that pet selection and traits can be updated anytime in settings.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 68.4% and high decision time.

pick_friend.hint: Don't worry! You can change your pet's accessories and style anytime after adoption.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint to pick_friend without altering required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the highest dropoff (31.6%); reassuring copy via config change carries low cost and good recovery potential.

candidates.title: home_intro_card_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home intro screen into a focused card layout with clear primary actions for desktop launch.
candidates.why: Finish stage mean completion time is 5815s with users reporting desktop launcher confusion.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage redesigns have shown consistent positive results (+3.4% lift) and directly address user confusion.

candidates.title: story_headline_clarity_copy
candidates.change: Updates story copy to clearly convey instant setup and quick desktop pet adoption.
candidates.why: Initial choose_path step sees 23.8% total dropoff right at onboarding start.

story.headline: Adopt a Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring a virtual pet directly onto your computer desktop screen in less than two minutes.

guard.reason: Updates story copy without violating copy or pricing constraints.

candidates.score_note: Copy change at entry step to clarify value proposition is config-only with low risk.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_founder_badge
candidates.change: Adds an official early adopter digital badge preview to the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Boosts motivation on adoption stage, which currently suffers from a 68.4% conversion dropoff.

guard.reason: Replaces the required official adoption stamp with an early adopter badge, losing the official stamp job.

candidates.title: sign_in_guest_account_hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint explaining that signing in prevents pet reset upon app reopens.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in or reopening.

sign_in.hint: Signing in saves your pet data securely so your companion never disappears on restart.

guard.reason: Adds a valid sign-in hint explaining data persistence.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel dropoff (27.1%) and 8 support emails point directly to guest account loss; simple hint fix.

candidates.title: new_pet_quick_start_flow
candidates.change: Reorders the onboarding sequence to conclude with a quick start guidance screen after home intro.
candidates.why: Users need immediate clarity after finishing onboarding on how to locate and interact with their desktop pet.

new_pet_quick_start.headline: Quick Desktop Tips
new_pet_quick_start.body: Look for your pet icon in your desktop tray to control or pause your pet at any time.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: upload_photos_checklist_layout
candidates.change: Switches the custom photo upload screen to a checklist layout showing photo guidelines.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure photos are clear and well-lit for optimal pet generation.

guard.reason: Requests personal photos or information from the user.
